name: CF-227 Badger "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
description:
Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner
Item Type: Laser Repeater
Size: 2

The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.
